content: Instead of purely looking forward with its headphone designs, Sony went back to its popular WH-1000XM4 design and made some improvements to make it even better. The 2026 version, called the WH-1000XM4C, sounds nearly as good as the pricier XM6 model (currently $348), but is down to $198 during Black Friday at Amazon, Best Buy, and Walmart. That’s $100 off their October launch price. [Product: Sony WH-1000XM4C | https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HFB8N519/?tag=theverge02-20, https://goto.walmart.com/c/482924/565706/9383?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.walmart.com%2Fip%2FSony-WH-1000XM4C-BLACK-Wireless-Premium-Noise-Cancelling-Headphones-2026%2F21074265247%2F, https://bestbuy.7tiv.net/c/482924/614286/10014?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bestbuy.com%2Fproduct%2Fsony-wh-1000xm4c-wireless-noise-cancelling-headphones-m4-2nd-gen-black%2FJ7XSRH5447%2Fsku%2F6689199%2F] There’s a reason why Sony went back to refine the XM4. Our former reviewer Chris Welch praised them for being super comfortable and for having close to perfect features for the price, especially compared to its successor, the XM3 (still my daily driver, for what it’s worth). The XM4s had better sound quality and noise cancellation, plus improved mics, multipoint connectivity, and a sensor that can detect when you remove them to automatically pause audio. Now, with the XM4C, there are further improvements, most notably a 10-band equalizer in the app (compared to the original XM4’s five-band) that my colleague John Higgins says really helped the headphones’ midrange frequencies open up. These are a great buy, but they aren’t your only Sony headphones deal to consider right now. Sony’s WH-1000XM5 are available during Black Friday at Best Buy for $169, their lowest price yet from a major retailer. There are upsides and downsides to this model: They feature improved noise cancellation thanks to more mics, despite using the same ANC chip as the XM4C, but they can’t fold up as compactly, making them a little bigger to pack in your bag. Either one you choose, you’ll have some great headphones to listen to going into 2027. Read our Sony WH-1000XM4C review.

chineseContent: 索尼并没有纯粹期待其耳机设计，而是回归了其流行的 WH-1000XM4 设计，并进行了一些改进，使其变得更好。 2026 年版本名为 WH-1000XM4C，听起来几乎与价格更高的 XM6 型号（目前售价 348 美元）一样好，但在黑色星期五期间，亚马逊、百思买和沃尔玛的售价降至 198 美元。这比 10 月份的发行价低了 100 美元。 [产品：索尼 WH-1000XM4C | https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HFB8N519/?tag=theverge02-20， https://goto.walmart.com/c/482924/565706/9383?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.walmart.com%2Fip%2FSony-WH-1000XM4C-BLACK-Wireless-Premium-Noise-Cancelling-Headphones-2026%2F21074265247%2F， https://bestbuy.7tiv.net/c/482924/614286/10014?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bestbuy.com%2Fproduct%2Fsony-w h-1000xm4c-无线降噪耳机-m4-2nd-gen-black%2FJ7XSRH5447%2Fsku%2F6689199%2F]索尼重新改进 XM4 是有原因的。我们的前评论员 Chris Welch 称赞它们超级舒适，并且在价格上拥有近乎完美的功能，特别是与它的后继者 XM3（仍然是我的日常驾驶，就其价值而言）相比。 XM4 具有更好的音质和噪音消除功能，以及改进的麦克风、多点连接和传感器，该传感器可以检测您何时移除它们以自动暂停音频。现在，XM4C 有了进一步的改进，最引人注目的是应用程序中的 10 频段均衡器（与原始 XM4 的 5 频段相比），我的同事 John Higgins 说这确实有助于耳机的中频打开。这些都是不错的选择，但它们并不是您现在唯一需要考虑的索尼耳机。索尼 WH-1000XM5 于黑色星期五期间在百思买 (Best Buy) 发售，售价为 169 美元，这是主要零售商迄今为止的最低价格。这种模式有优点也有缺点：
